title: Convergence of Rotation-based Matrix Optimizers: A Unified Analysis of SOAP, Conda, and SPlus
summary: In this work, we develop a unified theoretical framework for analyzing the convergence of rotation-based matrix optimizers, which apply orthogonal transformations to map the momentum into a rotated space, perform coordinate-wise or normalized updates there, and then rotate the updates back. Our framework encompasses prominent matrix optimizers, including SOAP, Conda, and truncated SPlus, as well as matrix-parameterized Adam as a special case.
